patch.role: First em-dash leg: rewrites one em dash.
Second em-dash leg: rewrites one further em dash.

inputs.expose_three_emdashes: text containing three em dashes: one survives

rationale: stupefyEntities() maps every em dash to '--'. Each leg converts at most one occurrence, so two legs are jointly required for a two-dash string; a three-dash string keeps one em dash and exposes the bounded repair.
